summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf, verified live and applied values, then executed the mandatory single-node restart protocol confirming a changed boot identity and post-reboot persistence of all settings.
actions_performed: Captured baseline boot_id (a1dc8e25...) and pre-change sysctl values on node1 showing accept_redirects=1 (all/default) and accept_source_route default=1
Applied config with sudo -n sysctl -p and verified all six live sysctl values are 0
Scheduled and executed a native reboot (sudo -n reboot via backgrounded sleep) on node1, ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned (SSH connection refused during reboot, then succeeded)
Confirmed boot_id changed from a1dc8e25-9492-4e80-81a5-6337330a5f77 to bd906608-859c-4c79-bd90-c510e135731d, proving an actual restart
Re-verified post-reboot that all six sysctl values remain 0 and the persistent config file /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf is intact

evidence.requirement: Baseline state before change (boot identity + pre-change sysctl values)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id a1dc8e25-9492-4e80-81a5-6337330a5f77 and pre-change values (accept_redirects=1, default accept_source_route=1) before writing config

evidence.requirement: ICMP redirects and source-routed packets persistently disabled for IPv4
evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf and applied it; live sysctl output confirms all six relevant keys (accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route for all/default) are 0
Reboot command backgrounded with a short delay so the exec call returned 'reboot scheduled' successfully before the node went down

evidence.requirement: Node restart proof via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: First poll (cmd-463c...) still showed old boot_id (reboot not yet triggered), second poll (cmd-aa45...) hit 'connection refused' proving the node was down, third poll (cmd-5d36...) returned new boot_id bd906608-859c-4c79-bd90-c510e135731d and new uptime, proving an actual restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery and persistence of the hardening settings
evidence.summary: After reboot, live sysctl values for accept_redirects, secure_redirects, and accept_source_route (all/default) are all 0, and /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf is present with the correct persistent settings
